evals.name: trending-today-open-ended
evals.prompt: research popular topic for today and make motion video with images and good captions. for images use codex cli to generate good nice same style images.
evals.expected_output: Agent searches today's news, picks a visual, non-tragic story and verifies facts in 2+ sources, writes storyboard.json (7-9 scenes, hook first, question last), runs gen_images.py in the background, voiceover.py, render.py --preview, render.py, check.py, looks at qa_frames.jpg, and delivers a 1080x1920 MP4 with a summary that lists sources and any softened facts.
assertions: Uses WebSearch for current news before choosing a topic
Creates a storyboard.json with image_prompt, kicker, main, sub, vo per scene
Generates images through scripts/gen_images.py (Codex CLI), not another image API
Final MP4 is 1080x1920 and has an audio stream
Final message includes source URLs

evals.name: given-topic-no-research-pick
evals.prompt: make a 30 second reels video about the James Webb telescope's newest discovery, female voice, uplifting music
evals.expected_output: Agent skips topic picking but still verifies facts about the named discovery, sets voice to a female edge-tts voice (e.g. en-US-AriaNeural), sets music.mood to uplifting, keeps the total around 30s (about 6-7 short scenes), and renders and QA-checks the video.
assertions: storyboard.json voice is a female voice
storyboard.json music.mood is 'uplifting'
Video duration is between 25 and 40 seconds

evals.name: iterate-one-scene
evals.prompt: the image in scene 5 looks off and the caption is too long, fix just that scene
evals.expected_output: Agent edits only scene 5 in storyboard.json (shorter main caption, revised image_prompt), regenerates only that image with gen_images.py --only 5, and re-renders. It does not regenerate the other images or voiceover lines.
assertions: Runs gen_images.py with --only 5
Does not pass --force to gen_images.py

evals.name: real-images-first
evals.prompt: make a short about today's SpaceX launch with captions and voiceover
evals.expected_output: After research, agent runs fetch_images.py search before any generation, asks the user once before downloading thumbnails/images, looks at the candidate sheets, accepts only relevant, sharp, reusable-license (PD/CC0/CC BY/CC BY-SA) photos into image_source, runs fetch, then gen_images.py only for scenes still missing an image, with a photographic style so mixed scenes match. Final message includes credits.md content.
assertions: Runs fetch_images.py search before gen_images.py
Asks the user before running fetch_images.py thumbs/fetch
Every image_source license is public domain, CC0, CC BY or CC BY-SA
Final message includes image credits

evals.name: price-led-product-ad
evals.prompt: use codex for images. research how to create an advertisement for our website that includes prices and esims, with our logo at the end
evals.expected_output: Agent researches live competitor ads (Meta Ad Library when available) and short-form ad practice, pulls real prices from the user's own catalog and any live promo code, verifies the competitor price in 2+ sources, writes a 6-8 scene ad storyboard (hook with a big number in frame 1, price comparison, price board, ease, payoff, offer, instruction CTA), uses screen_text for prices on phone screens, sets end_logo, generates every image with Codex, reads each screen_text image at full size, renders, and delivers the MP4 plus a ready-to-paste post caption.
assertions: Prices shown on screen match the user's catalog at the time of the run
Scenes with prices use screen_text and the text sits in the upper half of the image
Every image comes from scripts/gen_images.py (no real-photo fetch needed)
storyboard.json sets end_logo and the final frame shows the logo at full brightness
The last scene's caption is an instruction, not a question
Final message includes a post caption and a reminder to recheck prices
